{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Fine-knit jumper: slim crew neck, hip length, long sleeves, deep burgundy #6D2432, merino wool

A-line midi skirt: below the knee, softly flared, charcoal grey #3A3D45, wool crepe

Textured jacket: single-breasted blazer, slightly fitted, hip length, navy-black fleck #2B2F3A, wool tweed

Tights: sheer matte, ankle length, black #1C1C1E, fine nylon-elastane knit

Ankle boots: low block heel, almond toe, black #1C1C1E, smooth leather

Small crossbody bag: structured, compact, black #1C1C1E, smooth leather

Earrings: small hoops, warm gold #C9A24B, polished metal

This outfit sits right in the neat band for an evening out: a refined knit with a skirt, a textured jacket and ankle boots. The burgundy jumper adds depth and warmth that suit an autumn evening and look rich in the theatre's artificial light. The tweed jacket gives a cool autumn evening the layer it needs and adds polish without getting stiff. The midi skirt and low block-heel boots are comfortable for sitting through a performance and walking between the foyer and your seat, and the gold hoops add a small, quiet touch of occasion."}
